[!dolt] skip
# Test bd close and close_reason persistence
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Issue to close' --description 'Ready to close' --json
extractid ISSUE

bd close $ISSUE --reason Fixed
stdout 'Closed'

bd show $ISSUE --json
jq '.[0].issue.status'
stdout '"closed"'
jq '.[0].issue.close_reason'
stdout '"Fixed"'
